question: In which year India won gold in men's hockey in the Olympic games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1980.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India** won the **gold medal** in men's hockey at the** 1980 Olympic Games **held in **Moscow, USSR.**
 
• This was the **eighth time **that India had won a gold medal in men's hockey in the Olympic Games.<
